title: release-engineering-weekly-2026-03-10
content:
Release Engineering Weekly Notes — 2026-03-10

Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Liam Chen, Sofia Martinez, Diego Alvarez, Priya Nair, QA: Elena Rossi
Absent: N/A
Duration: 40m

Agenda:
- Status of current release train (2026.03.x)
- Hotfix deployment for RED-4123 (memory leak in kernel-serving path)
- Changelog updates and release notes deliverables
- Canary/rollout schedule for infra autoscaler change
- Action items and owners

1) Release train status (2026.03.2 -> next: 2026.03.3)
- Code freeze for features scheduled for 2026-03-15 train is 2026-03-12 EOD.
- Current candidate branch: release/2026.03.3. Includes: autoscaler tweaks (PR#5678), kv-cache improvements (PR#5692), and backport of stability patches.
- QA status: smoke tests green on staging (basic perf, regression, and long-run stability). Full perf regression running; ETA 2026-03-11 09:00 PT.
- Blockers: one flaky test in serving-runtime/test_attention.py (investigating) — assigned to Diego. If not resolved by 2026-03-11 12:00 PT, team will isolate the test and proceed with release candidate.

2) Hotfix: RED-4123 (memory leak observed in high-concurrency workloads)
- Incident summary: on 2026-03-08 we observed increasing memory usage on a subset of GPU nodes serving long-lived chat sessions. Root cause traced to KV cache eviction path under a race when eviction + migration occur simultaneously.
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5678 (backport to release/2026.03.x).
- Rollout plan: staged hotfix rollout immediately after meeting: canary -> 10% traffic for 30 minutes -> 50% for 30 minutes -> 100% with monitoring hold for 2h.
- Health checks: memory usage, OOM events, p99 latency, error-rate. Dashboard: Console -> release -> hotfix-RED-4123 (linked in runbook).
- Owner: Liam Chen. On-call: Priya Nair for the next 24h.
- Rollback criteria: any OOM spike above baseline +20% or sustained p99 latency increase > 50ms persist > 10 minutes. Rollback steps are in Confluence runbook (Confluence:release-runbook-2026-03).

3) Change log and release notes
- Required changelog entries:
  - autoscaler: improved capacity smoothing (PR#5678) — author: Sofia Martinez
  - kv-cache: eviction race fix (PR#5678 & PR#5692) — author: Diego Alvarez
  - minor CLI: add --dry-run flag for rollout (internal) — author: Elena Rossi
- Format: short summary (1 line), impact, risk, migration/rollback notes. Draft to be completed by 2026-03-11 EOD.
- Owner for release notes compilation: Aisha Patel. QA to verify wording for customer-facing notes.

4) Canary/rollout schedule: autoscaler change (dependent on hotfix)
- Plan: canary for autoscaler change will run on 2026-03-12 02:00 PT (low traffic window) with 1h canary at 5% -> 30% -> full. Both canary and hotfix share same health metrics but are independent rollouts.
- Metrics to watch: scale-up / scale-down jitter, pod churn, cold-start latency for new model pods, and cost delta.
- Dependencies: infra team needs to confirm new metrics exported by 2026-03-11 18:00 PT (Liam to follow up).

5) Hotfix retrospective notes (quick)
- Decision: backport and fast-track into the current release train due to customer impact risk.
- Communication: CS notified; status email sent to customers affected (template: hotfix-communication-2026-03).

6) Open action items
- Diego: stabilize failing attention test and either fix or quarantine by 2026-03-11 12:00 PT. If quarantined, add test ticket to RED-4210.
- Liam: execute hotfix rollout (PR#5678) today and monitor dashboards; update Slack #prod-alerts and #release-engineering after each stage.
- Sofia: finalize changelog entries and send draft to Aisha by 2026-03-11 EOD.
- Elena (QA): finish full perf regression and post results to the release checklist by 2026-03-11 09:00 PT.
- Priya: be primary on-call for the next 24 hours; coordinate with SRE if rollback needed.

7) Risks and mitigations
- Risk: hotfix introduces subtle latency regressions under synthetic load. Mitigation: short canary windows and explicit p99 latency thresholds for rollback.
- Risk: autoscaler change could cause transient pod churn impacting short requests. Mitigation: run autoscaler canary in low-traffic window and review scale metrics before full rollout.

8) Notes / Misc
- We agreed to add an automated guard in the pipeline to detect KV cache eviction races during CI (ticket being created).
- Reminder: Feature flags for any new behavioral changes (autoscaler smoothing) must be on-by-default=false for at least one release train.

Next meeting: 2026-03-17 10:00 PT (weekly sync).

Raw links and artifacts referenced in notes:
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5678
- KV-cache improvements: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5692
- Jira: RED-4123 (hotfix), RED-4210 (quarantine/test follow-up)
- Confluence runbook: Confluence:release-runbook-2026-03

End of notes.
